definitions.definition: The first self: the person made of the essence of food (annarasamaya), the outermost, person-shaped; head, wings, self and tail-support indicated as "this" (Taittirīya 2.1.1). Its embodied self is the prāṇamaya self (2.3.1).
The self within the food-made self and filling it; person-shaped; head prāṇa, right wing vyāna, left wing apāna, self ākāśa, tail and support earth (2.2.1).
The self within the breath-made self and filling it; person-shaped; head yajus, right wing ṛc, left wing sāman, self ādeśa, tail Atharvāṅgiras (2.3.1).
The self within the mind-made self and filling it; person-shaped; head śraddhā, right wing ṛta, left wing satya, self yoga, tail mahas (2.4.1).
The innermost of the five selves, within the understanding-made self and filling it; person-shaped; head priya, right wing moda, left wing pramoda, self ānanda, tail and support brahman (2.5.1).

literal: brahman is truth, knowledge, the infinite

definitions.definition: The characterization of brahman in the verse of Taittirīya 2.1.1.

The scale of Taittirīya 2.8: one human bliss (of a young, good, learned, strongest man owning the whole earth), each step a hundred times the last, through the human gandharvas, divine gandharvas, fathers, born-gods, karma-gods, gods, Indra, Bṛhaspati, Prajāpati to brahman; each step is also the bliss of a śrotriya not struck by desire.

literal: the knowledge of Bhṛgu taught by Varuṇa

definitions.definition: The knowledge that brahman is food, then breath, mind, understanding and finally bliss, reached by tapas at each step, established in the highest space (3.6.1).
The last member of each person-shaped self (earth for the breath-made self; brahman for the bliss-made self).
